description: r.main is cancelled with Deadline at 50, which t.a's sleep does not acknowledge, so t.a spawns into a closing region at 100. t.a.c1 is aborted twice in the poll that spawned it, before Rust's admission refused it; t.a.c2 is aborted twice after a yield, when the refusal has been delivered to its handle. Each abort is ASX_OK, and the joins observe the one refusal, ASX_E_REGION_CLOSED, with no value. twin_run took the refusal out of the handle at the first abort and a second one replaced it with PolledAfterCompletion, which failed the capture (bd-c129; fuzz seed 275 index 53).
